# ciphertrust_get_oci_buckets (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve a list of OCI object storage buckets available to the connection in the given compartment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ciphertrust_get_oci_buckets" "buckets" {
  # Required parameters
  connection_id  = "oci-connection-id-or-name"
  compartment_id = "compartment-ocid"
  # Optional parameters
  limit = 5
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `compartment_id` (String) Compartment OCID whose buckets are to be listed.
- `connection_id` (String) CipherTrust Manager OCI connection name or ID.

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Maximum total number of buckets to return. If omitted, all buckets are returned.

### Read-Only

- `buckets` (Attributes List) List of OCI object storage buckets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--buckets))

<a id="nestedatt--buckets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `buckets`

Read-Only:

- `compartment_id` (String) The OCID of the compartment that contains the bucket.
- `defined_tags` (Attributes Set) The defined tags of the bucket. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--buckets--defined_tags))
- `freeform_tags` (Map of String) The freeform tags of the bucket.
- `name` (String) The name of the bucket.
- `namespace` (String) The Object Storage namespace of the bucket.
- `time_created` (String) The date and time the bucket was created.

<a id="nestedatt--buckets--defined_tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `buckets.defined_tags`

Read-Only:

- `tag` (String) The tag's namespace.
- `values` (Map of String) The key:value pairs associated with the tag.
